headline: New US Legislation Aims to Cut Off China's Last Chipmaking Lifeline with Total Semiconductor Equipment Export Ban
summary: This proposed U.S. legislation represents a severe escalation in the tech trade war, aiming to completely cut off China's access to critical semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including DUV lithography. Such a ban would severely cripple China's domestic chip production capabilities, fragmenting global semiconductor supply chains and profoundly impacting future AI infrastructure development.
